meta.ogDescription: CRWV: AI Cloud Infrastructure leader, 110% rev growth, NVIDIA-backed, 60% off highs. Analyst target $121. Asymmetric setup at $73.

verdict.summary: CoreWeave is the leading pure-play AI cloud infrastructure company in the US. Originally founded as Atlantic Crypto Corporation in 2017, it pivoted to GPU cloud computing in 2019 and now operates NVIDIA-powered data centers at scale. Revenue surged 110% YoY to $5.13B in FY2025, with 71.7% gross margins. However, the stock has plunged 60% from its June 2025 ATH of ~$187, hammered by concerns over $14.9B in capex, $29.8B in debt, and a Q4 earnings miss on Feb 26. At $72.90, the stock trades at 12.7x EV/Revenue — a steep discount to its growth profile. NVIDIA holds a 10% stake. Analyst consensus target is $121.
